item.title: Celebrating 50 years of punk at @100clublondon. For over 80 years, the Horton family have been at the helm of The 100 Club, pioneering new eras of ico...
item.description:
Celebrating 50 years of punk at @100clublondon.   For over 80 years, the Horton family have been at the helm of The 100 Club, pioneering new eras of iconic musicians and having had everyone from the likes of the Rolling Stones, Paul Weller, Sex Pistols, Sleaford Mods, Amy Winehouse and countless icons who have graced its iconic stage. 
We caught up with the family ahead of their 50 years show with @georgecoxfootwear , spoke to the community who keep this iconic venue alive and strapped in for an evening of unfiltered punk chaos.

Performances from @sprintsmusic @crows_band @bathingsuitsband @marujaofficial @opuskink @waxhead.band @lettsdon, @jehnnybeth and more 🖤

Full video on YouTube now.

item.title: From the amp that started it all… to the new 1959BJA. ⚡️
item.description:
From the amp that started it all… to the new 1959BJA. ⚡️

The iconic roaring sound of 'Dookie' comes from legendary producer's, Rob Cavallo's studio, where the original sound of Dookie was created with the powerhouse that is a 1959SLP. 🤘

Now we continue the legacy of that tone - Developed in close collaboration with Billie, the 1959BJA captures the raw intensity and unmistakable crunch of the original, offering greater consistency and versatility.

If you're looking for authentic Dookie tone, the 1959BJA is ready to deliver.

Watch this space. 👀

See the full Dookie story on marshall.com 🔗

item.title: Ever wondered how we cover our amps? It’s all done by hand! 🤘 Join Paul at the bench today as he covers a 2203.
item.description:
Ever wondered how we cover our amps? It’s all done by hand! 🤘 Join Paul at the bench today as he covers a 2203.

Each amp shell begins its journey at the wood mill before making its way to our covering team, where it’s wrapped in tolex using heat-activated glue. From there, it lands on Paul’s bench, where he expertly makes precise incisions to perfectly “wrap” the amp around every edge and corner.

Once Paul’s finished, it’s ready to head over to the finishing team for the final touches. ⚡️

It’s a hands-on process that takes skill, precision and plenty of practice!

item.title: Tiny rooms. Sticky floors. Nights you don’t forget.
item.description:
Tiny rooms. Sticky floors. Nights you don’t forget.

Marshall started in a small shop in Hanwell - but grew on stages like these.

Grassroots venues are where it begins. Where bedroom musicians become bands and where the loudest scenes start quietly.

When a venue disappears, it’s more than a room that’s lost. It’s a first set. A shared moment. A place where people figure out who they are.

Without them, there’s no next wave of live music. And no next chapter of Marshall.

Keep live music alive.

Made of Loud. Made of these rooms. Made of the people in them.

#MadeOfLoud

Find out more: marshall.com Link in bio.
